headline: Approved $129,150.00 for Moshassuck Street soil disposal and a referenda self-mailer contract with $5,586.00 printing and $17,556.00 postage.
summary: Approved a $129,150.00 proposal to dispose of soil from the Moshassuck Street right-of-way, paid from the Sewer Bond. Approved a contract with Graphic Image of Milton, CT, for referenda self-mailers. Approved permission to advertise an RFP for snow plowing and sanding services.
decisions: Approved the August 27, 2026 meeting minutes, unanimously.
Approved the award of RFP # 27-002 for 2026 Board of Canvassers referenda self-mailers to Graphic Image of Milton, CT, with $5,586.00 for printing and $17,556.00 for postage, unanimously.
Approved permission to advertise an RFP for snow plowing and sanding services, unanimously.
Approved a $129,150.00 proposal from International Paving of West Warwick to dispose of soil on Moshassuck St, paid from the Sewer Bond, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: August 27, 2026 meeting minutes have been accepted. Jeannine Bourski makes a motion to approve. Nancy Pelletier seconds. Unanimously approved

an award has been made for RFP # 27-002 - 2026 Board of Canvassers Referenda Self-Mailers, to Graphic Image of Milton, CT... Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Jeannine Bourski seconds. Unanimously approved.

Rick Karsulavitch, DPW, requests permission to advertise an RFP for Snow Plowing and Sanding Services for the upcoming winter, all expenses budgeted yearly in General Fund 100. Mark Wildenhain makes a motion to approve. Lisa Bessette seconds. Unanimously approved..
Agreed-to proposal in the amount of $129,150.00 to be paid out of the Sewer Bond. Nancy Pelletier makes a motion to approve. Mark Wildenhain seconds. Unanimously approved
